name: labs/tiagocoutinho__julabo
title: JULABO circulator (julabo.JulaboCF)
intro: JULABO circulator (julabo.JulaboCF), adapted from tiagocoutinho/julabo. It reads `bath_temperature`, `external_temperature`, `active_set_point_channel`, `running` and 1 more; sets `setpoint`; runs `start_circulation` and `stop_circulation`. `start_circulation`: start the circulator (the native start). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
